caption:
Toto loves a long weekend ride, but his neck is stiff every time he gets home.

On the bike, your neck holds your head up for hours so you can see the road. The lower the position, the harder those muscles work.

A reach that's too long or bars that are too low can add strain, so a set-up check can help. Move between the hoods, tops and drops, sit up on quiet stretches and gently turn your head. Off the bike, chin tucks and rows twice a week build capacity.

Pain spreading into the arm, pins and needles, hand weakness, building headaches or neck pain after a crash are worth an assessment. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 🐰
